_provenance.override: the engine's validated coding preset (tool-heavy, any length, dedup loose), restated as this theme's delta over the global policy
_provenance.min_user_turns: 3 — a coding session carries real back-and-forth; from the same preset
_provenance.max_tool_ratio: 1.0 — tool-heavy is the point: no ceiling (the preset's 'tool-heavy')
_provenance.require_end_turn: false — a coding run may legitimately end mid-tool-call (the preset's 'any length')
_provenance.dedup_threshold: 0.8 — loose: template re-runs differ only in surface detail (the preset's 'dedup loose')
_provenance.min_user_msg_chars / max_first_msg_chars: 0 — any length; the length stage stays open for coding content
